body:
Version 5.0.0
• Global rules: allow/block an address, port or protocol for all apps
• Direct rules can block, per Wi-Fi/mobile/VPN
• System services without an app can be allowed/blocked
• Faster, atomic rule apply; rewritten root engine
• Backups in Download/AFWall, all profiles
• Log history up to 90 days; allow/block from the log
• Safer custom scripts with live checks and snippets
• Android 16, Private Space and many other fixes

Full changelog: https://github.com/ukanth/afwall/blob/beta/Changelog.md
